Corporate integration requested by the project owner. Original ownership applies;
the upstream README does not grant an open-source license for code/fonts/brand assets.
This notice does not grant additional redistribution rights.

Node BI adaptations live in app/globals.css, app/corporate.css and React components.
Upstream DOM form/dialog event handlers and document renderer are not initialized:
React retains ownership of application interaction, validation and saved data.
Do not update these files from an unpinned remote URL at runtime.
